U_0x014C8A:
Built by the Holy Kingdom of Langran in <La Gias>. Blessed by wind spirit Cyfis, called the "<Masoukishin> of the Wind." Its Fulcanelli perpetual engine needs the pilot's <Prana> (ki/aura) for peak output, so power depends on pilot aptitude.
Airtight frame allows underwater/space use; self-circulation system protects the pilot on long sorties. Aether, massless energy at rest in absolute coordinates, fuels its magic propulsion. Orichalconium armor, sealed with numerological wards at particle level, gives high magic defense.
Its Laplace Demon computer predicts events via causality, but this depends on the pilot's own magic. "Cybuster" is a ward-name against magic attack, not its true name.
U_0x0156CD: VThe Valsione, 2nd Valsion-series unit, enhanced with <La Gias> alchemy. ABMD drives its frame and DML traces the pilot's motions, giving flexible, human-like movement unmatched by other humanoid weapons.
U_0x0158A0: SShu's anti-alien <Armored Module>. Runs on an antimatter engine, armored in ultra-tensile titanium reinforced at particle level. Built for firepower/defense over mobility; attack power is immense - co-designer Eric Wong said a superhuman pilot could crush world forces in a day. Shu's Kabbalah program reportedly taps astral energy. Hides many black boxes; since Shu went independent after the <DC War>, its secrets stay a mystery.
U_0x0171A6: A highly mobile wind <Elemental> built for hit-and-run. Standard armament trails other <Elemental>s, so weak pilots can't unlock its full power. Output is stable and its spirit accepts almost any pilot - hence the mass-produced Gadyful. Its spirit is Soleid of the Sandstorm, a low-rank wind spirit.
U_0x0173AA: A super <Elemental> designed by Xenia. Unlike normal <Elemental>s, it draws on Huckebein series data, giving a distinct look. No spirit contract, but its pseudo-<Prana> generator lets a high-<Prana> pilot rival a <Masoukishin>. Tradeoff: short operating time.
U_0x0192E6: A Re-Technologist humanoid weapon built for aerial/ranged combat. Besides arm-mounted Vector Guns and Force Busters, it can swap both arms for weapons launched from its WBH "Ars Nova." Like the Aile Chevalier, it carries "Sympathia" and "Res Arcana."
U_0x019755: A special Re-Technologist humanoid weapon: Ganador and Strega transformed and combined. Its two Res Arcanas grant immense power.
U_0x000FDE: Unit 2 of the R Series <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-2 POWERED." A heavy beam-bombardment <Personal Trooper> carrying the <Tronium> Engine that powers the SRX. High firepower/armor, but unstable engine output and poor mobility; in the R Series it handles suppressive fire and artillery support. Plus parts - Hyzol Launcher (heavy metal particle cannon) and shoulder armor - make it R-2 Powered. In combined SRX, R-2's pilot regulates engine output, handles damage control, and monitors other pilots. No <T-LINK System>, so its pilot need not be a Psychodriver.
